name: pam_systemd
detailed_description: Systemd session management module that creates and manages systemd user sessions. Integrates login sessions with systemd's session tracking and cgroup management. Provides proper session lifecycle management for modern Linux distributions.
notes:
Creates systemd user session and user@uid.service scope
